svg.title: Vord, the manuscript-guard mascot, stands before a manuscript. Mistakes run at it one by one, and Vord's shield blocks each, showing the gate that catches it: a typed number (G2), a results file edited by hand (G1), a retracted work and a DOI that names another (G7), a plan rewritten after the results (G12), Methods out of date with the analysis (G9). Two shadows, confirmation bias and data leakage, pass through the shield, and a co-author reads the manuscript through a magnifying glass. With motion turned off, the picture holds still on the first mistake blocked and the co-author reading.
